answer: Fatigue cap: a grader's first 12 seals per epoch pay the full rate, seals 13 to 24 pay 50 percent, and anything beyond 24 pays zero. The Mesa tier is that flat 50 percent plateau, so a grader earns at most 12 + 6 = 18 full-rate units per epoch. Failure mode: one operator splits work over 3 wallets to dodge the cap. Check rule: wallets sharing a Harbor, the funding source that first paid their bond, are summed as one grader. Pigment is the tag on each seal naming that funding source, written at deal time. Cheapest bypass: fund wallets from different exchanges, unless the tag audit links them.
